architecture_summary: React + Vite + Tailwind CSS educational management app. Features student roster, grade tracking, course progress, attendance logging, and performance analytics with localStorage mock persistence.

tickets.title: State store and mock data provider
tickets.description: Create global React context for students, courses, grades, attendance logs, and notifications. Support localStorage persistence.
acceptance_criteria: Provide state for students, courses, attendance, grades, notifications
Include CRUD methods for student records and grade entries
Seed realistic initial mock dataset if localStorage empty

tickets.title: Dashboard overview and metric cards
tickets.description: Build main dashboard view with KPI counters, recent student activity, upcoming deadlines, and quick action bar.
acceptance_criteria: Display total students, active courses, average attendance rate, and passing rate KPIs
Render recent submissions feed and alerts for at-risk students
Provide quick-filter controls for academic terms

tickets.title: Student roster and profile view modal
tickets.description: Build searchable, filterable student directory table with status badges and detail drawer modal.
acceptance_criteria: Filter students by grade level, course enrollment, and academic status
Search bar with live filtering by name or ID
Modal view showing detailed student GPA, attendance history, and notes

tickets.title: Course curriculum and module tracker
tickets.description: Create course management page displaying syllabus milestones, completion bars, and instructor details.
acceptance_criteria: Grid of enrolled courses with progress percentages
Interactive module checklist to toggle completed topics
Filter courses by department and semester

tickets.title: Assessments gradebook and daily attendance log
tickets.description: Build grade entry matrix and date-based attendance checklist with instant status toggling.
acceptance_criteria: Gradebook table with inline score editing and letter grade calculation
Attendance sheet allowing Present, Absent, Late marks per student
Bulk mark actions (Mark all Present)

tickets.title: Performance analytics and report exporter
tickets.description: Create visual charts page for grade distribution, attendance trends, and CSV data export.
acceptance_criteria: Visual grade distribution bar breakdown and cohort comparison
Attendance trend line chart using SVG or lightweight bars
Export roster and performance report to CSV button

tickets.title: App shell and navigation wiring (src/App.jsx)
tickets.description: Wire sidebar navigation, responsive header with notifications, top search, theme state, and page routing.
acceptance_criteria: Responsive sidebar with links to Dashboard, Students, Courses, Assessments, Attendance, Analytics
Wrap root in EduTrackProvider context
Clean mobile drawer navigation toggle
